list.name: Changes
list.comment: feat: migrate to MySQL backend with SHA-256 secure authentication - Transitioned data storage from localStorage to a remote MySQL database. - Implemented Next.js Server Actions for secure, server-side CRUD operations. - Added SHA-256 password hashing (salted with email) for enhanced security. - Refactored AuthProvider and UI components to handle asynchronous DB actions. - Fixed React rendering warnings by moving navigation logic into useEffect. - Added a standalone database connection test script and .env template.
